text:
zoe: FYI, EU customer raised a DPA erasure. They claim our platform returned success but downstream storage still has their data. They see a 401 when our delete job hits the tenant KMS/HSM proxy. Need help confirming scope and producing deletion evidence for legal.

liam: can you paste the exact error and the request id? Also which tenant (dedicated?) and model/route?

zoe: Dedicated tenant: tenant-id 24f8c. Customer-facing ticket includes logs. Internal delete job shows:
```
DELETE /v1/tenants/24f8c/objects/batch HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
x-request-id: 8f3a-77b2
Response: 500 -> downstream KMS proxy returned 401 when trying to unwrap key for key_id=ks_az-08
Error: HSM_AUTH_FAILURE: authentication to HSM failed (status=401)
```
They ran the job twice; first run reported success at API layer (we returned 200) but the background worker log shows the HSM failure and mark-uncommitted. Customer wants proof of deletion or a timeline.

nina: do we have audit logs showing attempted KMS operations and which service principal was used? For GDPR erasure we need: API audit (who requested), KMS unwrap attempts (key id, response codes), and storage delete confirmation (object ids).

devon: quick checks: 1) confirm dedicated tenant's key mapping in our KMS proxy config, 2) check if HSM credential rotation happened around the timestamps, 3) x-request-id 8f3a-77b2 is helpful — pass it to the infra logs query.

zoe: adding the minimal repro we used (with redacted secrets) — small curl that the customer's infra ran:
```bash
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/tenants/24f8c/erase" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-redacted" \
  -d '{"scope":"full","object_ids":["obj-120","obj-121"]}'
# server returns 200-ok quickly but backend shows HSM 401 in worker logs
```
They also reported a spike in latency right before the 401s.

liam: I queried infra logs for x-request-id 8f3a-77b2. I can see the API layer returned 200 at 2025-11-02T14:12:05Z, but the background worker (worker-7) shows: KMS proxy request to hsm-vendor failed with 401 at 2025-11-02T14:12:07Z. Worker retried twice then marked as failed.

nina: @devon can you pull the KMS proxy logs for that tenant and timeframe and check the SPN / client cert presented to HSM? We need e2e chain for audit evidence. Also need to know if any subprocessor (HSM vendor) had an incident this window.

audit-bot: Retrieved logs: https://internal-logs.redwood/trace/8f3a-77b2 (access limited) :mag:

devon: I pulled the proxy logs. We see TLS handshake ok, but HSM returns 401 with body: {"error":"client_not_authorized","detail":"signature invalid or client cert revoked"}. No rotation events in our KMS proxy config around that time, but checking with secops on cert revocation list.

zoe: customer asked for ETA to provide deletion evidence to legal. They want a signed statement and logs showing final delete.

liam: immediate remediation plan: 1) collect full audit bundle (API request, worker logs, KMS proxy logs, HSM vendor response, object-store delete markers) for tenant 24f8c; 2) attempt a controlled re-run against a sandbox key to reproduce; 3) if HSM auth is intermittent, open vendor support case. I can own bundles. ETA EOD if no vendor delay. :thumbsup:

nina: add me on the vendor support thread and include DPA ticket id so we can track legal/regulatory comms. Also prepare an interim statement saying we're investigating and will provide evidence.

devon: repro steps for infra to try (internal):
```bash
# run in staging with tenant mapping and a test key
python infra/tools/erase_repro.py --tenant 24f8c --objects obj-120 --dry-run=false --log-level=debug
# capture outbound KMS call with tcpdump:
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 port 443 and host hsm-vendor -w hsm-trace.pcap
```
Note: set env HSM_TEST_KEY to ks_az-08 to match production flow.

zoe: I'll tell the customer: we found KMS auth failures in our backend. We're collecting audit logs and will share evidence once we confirm final object state. ETA EOD internal, might extend if vendor takes longer.

liam: sending bundle to /secure-share/dpa-bundles/24f8c/8f3a-77b2.tar.gpg now. Contents: api_request.json, worker-log.txt, kms-proxy.log, hsm-response.json (vendor), storage-delete-markers.json.

nina: I've reviewed the bundle and flagged the vendor response. Filing subprocessor incident ticket and looping legal. If vendor confirms client cert revoked, we need written confirmation for the DPA response.

zoe: thanks all — passing update to customer. Will keep thread updated. :pray:

devon: follow-up note — we should consider adding a small reconciliation job that verifies storage delete markers after DPA erasure and retries or raises a high-severity pager on mismatch. Filing infra ticket: INF-4823.

zoe: noted. closing loop with customer after vendor reply.

liam: if anyone needs copies of specific logs DM me, I'll share least-priv access.

zoe: thanks :heart:
